mark_price_update_triggered.meaning: admin sets the mark price, triggering _cacheImpactPrice

expired_orders_present_in_queue.meaning: expired orders remain in the limit order queue at the time of the impact price computation

low_liquidity_present.meaning: low-liquidity conditions exist in the market

impact_price_includes_unexecutable_liqui.meaning: the impact price snapshot includes liquidity that would never execute (expired orders contributing to baseAmount)

funding_payments_false_occurred.meaning: funding payments and safety checks relying on markPrice can become false due to the distorted mark price
funding_payments_false_occurred.checkpoint: after mark price derived from impact price

assumptions: The admin setting the mark price is the trigger for _cacheImpactPrice; no unauthorized-caller claim is made.
Expired orders are present in the queue at the time of the impact price computation.
Low-liquidity conditions hold in the market during the computation.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete numeric bound or observed value for the impact price or mark price mismatch; the relation is represented qualitatively.
Whether expired orders are present at the time of a specific _cacheImpactPrice call is not established by a prior transaction fragment.

limitations: The selected impact is potential; the plan formalizes only the report-supported conditional scenario, not an inevitable effect.
The relation is expressed with grounded Boolean observables because the report provides no numeric operands for the impact price or mark price.
Other impacts (impact price snapshot inclusion, manipulation flowing into markPrice) are handled in separate claim-generation passes and are not covered here.
